findings.description: I-1 Remove vegetation from roof surfaces of 2205 and 2207 Northwood; check all drains for clear operation and remove silt/vegetation build-up (CRA: Roof Tune-Up - 2205 & 2207)

I-2 Repair foam applied gravel surface roof on 2203 Marvel: exposed foam degrading from UV; installer to prep, recoat foam membrane and resurface gravel; apply gravel stop throughout (as at southwest corner) since gravel is washing into gutters (CRA: Roof Tune-Up/Repair - 2203)

RR-1 Five-year service on roof membrane over 2203 Marvel: installer to inspect, repair blistered and bare areas, recoat flashings and other areas exposed without gravel (CRA: 5 Year Service - 2203 Roof)
RR-2 Repair paved surface around the project as necessary and re-stripe for car parking - Year 3 (CRA: Paving Repair & Stripe, $15,000 total across Years 3 and 9)
RR-2 Repair paved surface around the project as necessary and re-stripe for car parking - Year 9
RR-3 Continued replacement of older air conditioning units within tenant suites at $475 each, one installed per year Years 1 through 10 (CRA: A/C Units; table total $4,750)
Remove vegetation and debris from roof surfaces and monitor minor ponding on 2205 for need of an additional drain (narrative; vegetation removal covered by I-1)
Remove tenant-accumulated debris from gravel lot behind 2203 Marvel (Photo #48); consideration could be given to paving the lot but not made a requirement of the report
